title: alchemilla vulgaris var. euobtusa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. euobtusa, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species within the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing menstrual cramps and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include its ability to stimulate uterine contractions, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating menstrual disorders and postpartum hemorrhage. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla vulgaris var. euobtusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
